pro_course_detail.title: 🌱 Story Class 1. – Mini Stories (Vocabulary)
pro_course_detail.description:
Are you struggling to remember vocabulary? Then this class is perfect for you. 

The problem with regular vocabulary classes is you don't understand the word in context. 

Learning words requires becoming friends with the new word. You must get to know the meaning, the sound and the feeling. 

~~~~~~~~~~~~~

In this class: 

1) We use translation to establish meaning (conceptual learning)
2) We play with the sound of the word (neurolinguistic learning)
3) We create a gesture to represent the new word (kinaesthetic learning)
4) We create a mini stories using the new words (associative learning)

~~~~~~~~~~~~~

Students love this class because they effortlessly learn new words and they never forget them. 

In every class, you will acquire four new words and you will create a meaningful mini story.

~~~~~~~~~~~~~

After each class, you will get a mini story: READING (PDF) and LISTENING (MP3).

~~~~~~~~~~~~~

PACKAGES: 

10 lessons = 10 Mini Stories classes

pro_course_detail.title: 🌳  Story Class 2. – Big Stories (Fluency)
pro_course_detail.description:
Do you want to improve all of your English skills? Big Stories is perfect for you. 

In this class you will 1) create an entire story from start to finish and 2) get study materials. 

Students love this class because they see their ideas made into a creative story. 

~~~~~~~~~~~~~

After this class, you will get your story: READING (PDF) and LISTENING (MP3). 

The story is 80% my words. The story is over 2000 words. The audiobook is between 7 - 10 minutes long.  

~~~~~~~~~~~~~

Story Class helps students feel relaxed, inspired and happy. Students focus on the meaning of their story, not the language. This approach aligns with how decades of research says we learn languages. 

Don't worry if you don't have a story idea. I'm passionate about making stories. I will support you and help you. Students always have wonderful ideas.

Since discovering Story Class in 2020, I've found that it is the most reliable, stress-free, efficient and effective teaching method. As a general method, it engages every student, helping to create meaningful experiences in the language. 

For the teacher, Story Class dramatically reduces class preparation time and significantly simplifies what we do in the class. All that is needed is to know the principles of effective language acquisition and to develop interpersonal skills to execute an effective Story Class.

-Broaden and deepen your vocabulary by defining and discussing words that are new to you

pro_course_detail.title: *Live* Proofreading and Writing Feedback
pro_course_detail.description:
Have you written something - a story, an essay, an email, or something else - that you'd like a native speaker to read through and correct? Do you also want explanations of these corrections so you can improve your writing permanently? I've got you covered!

In these classes, we will go through a text that you've written, with me making corrections and explaining as needed. If you have grammar questions that come up as we're discussing the corrections, I'll answer those too. Studying philosophy at university allowed me to develop a strong grasp of academic writing conventions, and I can also help you with more informal writing styles.

Our proofreading will begin live. If at the end of the lesson we haven't finished the text you sent me, we can 1) continue in another live session, or 2) finish asynchronously, with me correcting and providing comments outside of lesson time. 

If you choose to finish asynchronously, you can pay me by booking a "lesson" (or several) of the same length of time as I spent making corrections outside of class. (Naturally, neither of us will show up for this "lesson"!)

Please be reasonable in your expectations as to how much we can proofread in one lesson. How much text we can cover will of course depend on the length of the text, but also on its complexity and on how many errors it contains.
